results.title: Ciudad de muertos
results.overview: Enrique Metinides, renowned crime photographer, discovers his passion as a child when his camera captures a haunting image of death. This obsession with documenting tragedy shapes his career and transforms his work into art. But as a mysterious figure begins appearing in his photographs, Enrique unravels a chilling secret linking his lens to the shadows of politics and the supernatural.

results.title: From the Heart
results.overview: Ana is a dedicated housekeeper, considered "part of the family". When her employer demands cod for an important dinner, and there is none at home, the desperate search for the ingredient turns into anxiety, pushing Ana to her breaking point.

results.title: Last Chance Motel
results.overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

results.title: Butterfly Jam
results.overview: 16 years old Pyteh splits his time between the wrestling mat and his family’s struggling Circassian diner in Newark. A single impulsive decision by his hustling father changes the course of his life, shaping a tale of pride, legacy, and masculinity.

results.title: Lady
results.overview: A narcissistic, lonely aristocrat hires an opportunistic filmmaker to document her lavish life, but her desperate bid for fame turns surreal when she literally begins to vanish from sight.

results.title: The Confession
results.overview: A woman finds her late father’s tape confessing to murder tied to an evil force—now her son shows the same darkness, and she must fight to stop it.

results.title: PoderMania~! 2026
results.overview: The ‘Power of Lucha' ignites the Las Vegas Strip as PoderMania~! makes its high-octane debut as part of The Collective 2026. Streaming live on TrillerTV+, this afternoon spectacle at Horseshoe Las Vegas kicks off the Wednesday festivities of The Collective and TrillerTV's Mania Week.

results.title: The Boy with My Son's Face
results.original_title: The Boy with My Son's Face
results.overview: Susan's baby dies, and she is convicted for a crime she doesn’t even remember committing. Years later, out on parole and fighting to start over, Susan sees a photograph that stops her cold.

results.title: Flag Day
results.overview: Set in the small farming community of Three Oaks, Michigan — home to the nation’s largest Flag Day parade — FLAG DAY is a verité portrait of ritual, identity, and belonging in an era of deep political division. Somewhere between tradition and transformation lies this village, whose annual parade has become a pageant of American aspiration and memory. Over the course of Flag Day weekend, the film immerses viewers in the lives of a diverse cross-section of townspeople: veterans, local business owners, marching bands, and volunteers who, for one weekend each June, create an event that is at once nostalgic and reflective of the tensions of our time. Their stories reveal both the beauty and the fragility of community life in a time of polarization. FLAG DAY was filmed in an observational, verité style, capturing moments of humor, conflict, and grace as the community prepares for its defining ritual.

results.title: Alpha Gang
results.overview: The Alpha Gang are alien invaders sent on a mission to conquer Earth. Disguised in human form, armed and dangerous, and clad in 1950’s leather biker get-up, they show no mercy… until they catch the most toxic, contagious human disease of all: emotion.

results.title: Narciso
results.overview: Narciso is a Black orphan living with siblings Carmem and Joaquim. Just before his birthday, he is returned by a couple who decided not to adopt him. To cheer him up, Alexandre, another child living in the foster home, gives him a magical basketball. If Narciso makes three baskets, a genie will appear to grant him his greatest wish.

results.title: Brohr
results.overview: In the near future in Blokhavn, 24-year-old craftsman Ali lives in the ghetto area Valhalalparken with his wife Yasmina. Their everyday life changes drastically when the rich man Jasper Puch sends high-tech robots into the labor market, which immediately take over all the underpaid jobs. The residents of Valhalalparken, including Ali and Yasmina, lose their income and are reluctantly forced to relocate to Nakskov on Lolland. In the meantime, the robots start demolishing Valhalalparken so that expensive luxury apartments can be built for the rich citizens. However, Ali refuses to let go of his beloved hometown and decides to gather his old group of friends Hassan, Davito, Ahmed, Abdi, Musti, even though they are no longer on speaking terms. Ali manages to persuade them, and together they go on a wild and crazy adventure in the fight against the robots and Jasper Puch to win back their jobs and their beloved Blokhavn.

results.title: How FIFA Chooses the World Cup Final Referee
results.original_title: Så går det till när Fifa väljer VM-finaldomare
results.overview: See how the process works and who Jonas Eriksson thinks will get the chance to referee the 2026 World Cup final.

results.title: Родная
results.overview: At the heart of the narrative lies the touching story of an elderly couple whose love is put to the test by time, illness, and technological progress. An unusual helper enters their lives—a modern robotic rover—which unexpectedly becomes a bridge between the past and the present. Through the lens of technology, the film explores timeless themes: love, memory, family bonds, and humanity.

results.title: Lure
results.overview: After being invited to a party by a mysterious and alluring woman, six men awake to find themselves part of a cult family's gruesome annual tradition to find the perfect suitor.

results.title: Paging Hezbollah
results.overview: Paging Hezbollah is the extraordinary true story behind an intelligence operation that seemed impossible—how it was conceived, engineered and carried out, as well as the profound geopolitical consequences that followed.

results.title: Four Minus Three
results.overview: Barbara and her partner Heli are professional clowns, living out their dream of an alternative, joy filled life with their two children, laughing at what doesn't work out. But when a tragic car accident takes Heli and the children, Barbara is left alone. In the face of unspeakable loss, her belief in humor, hope, and humanity is put to the ultimate test. Can her way of seeing the world — through both its light and shadow — help her find a way back to life? She bets she'll laugh again.

results.title: Blood Money
results.overview: When Adam's abusive father leave him and his mother with a looming $40,000 house payment, Adam joins a gang in search for money.
